title: Zechariah Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Zechariah 2: the man with the measuring line, Jerusalem without walls, and the call to be silent before Yahweh.

questions.text: What did the man have in his hand, in the vision at the start of the chapter?
questions.explanation: He lifted up his eyes and saw a man with a measuring line in his hand.

answers.text: A sword
A plumb line
A measuring line
A flying scroll

questions.text: Where did the man say he was going?
questions.explanation: He said he was going to measure Jerusalem, to see what is its width and what is its length.

answers.text: To measure Jerusalem
To the land of the north
To the house of Josiah
To the mountains of bronze

questions.text: How will Jerusalem be inhabited, according to the word for the young man?
questions.explanation: Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of men and livestock in it.

answers.text: As a fortress with high towers
As villages without walls
As a city of priests only
As a camp around the temple

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will be around her?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will be to her a wall of fire around it, and he will be the glory in the middle of her.

answers.text: A hedge of thorns
A rampart of stone
A cloud of smoke
A wall of fire

questions.text: As what does Yahweh say he has spread them abroad?
questions.explanation: Yahweh calls them to flee from the land of the north, for he has spread them abroad as the four winds of the sky.

answers.text: As sheep without a shepherd
As chaff on the threshing floor
As the four winds of the sky
As stars in the heavens

questions.text: Who are told to escape in the next call?
questions.explanation: The call is, "Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon."

answers.text: Those who dwell in Egypt
Those who dwell with the daughter of Babylon
Those who dwell in the holy mountain
Those who dwell among the nations of the south

questions.text: What does the text say about the one who touches you?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies says that he who touches you touches the apple of his eye.

answers.text: He touches the apple of his eye
He touches the hem of his robe
He touches a wall of fire
He touches the crown of the king

questions.text: What will happen to the nations over which Yahweh shakes his hand?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will shake his hand over them, and they will be a plunder to those who served them.

answers.text: They will serve in the temple of Yahweh
They will be driven to the land of the north
They will bring an offering to Jerusalem
They will be a plunder to those who served them

questions.text: What does Yahweh promise the daughter of Zion as she is told to sing and rejoice?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "Behold, I come, and I will dwell within you."

answers.text: That he will send a prophet to her
That he will give her silver and gold
That he will come and dwell within her
That he will build her a wall of stone

questions.text: What is all flesh told to do before Yahweh at the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Be silent, all flesh, before Yahweh, for he has roused himself from his holy habitation.

answers.text: To shout before him
To be silent before him
To bring their offerings
To flee from him
